subject: Final hours: candidate decision and sign-on concession
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate update — Caroline Nguyen received competing offer, asks for quick decision

Ben / Jonas — quick heads up. Sara from Greystone just flagged that Caroline (SWE-III candidate) received a competing offer this morning and needs a decision by end-of-day Friday PT. She said the other offer has a slightly higher base (+8%) and a larger prorated equity grant in year one.

Caroline is enthusiastic about Redwood (team fit, the inference work, and infra ownership) but the competing offer tightens her window. She asked whether we can: 
- confirm final base and band placement,
- consider a one-time sign-on to bridge, and
- lock a guaranteed start date (helps with her counterparty).

I ran a quick comp check with Marissa and we may have limited headroom in band without approval. Can we get a fast OK to offer a sign-on and a small base uplift if needed? If we can't compete on base, an above-band sign-on + guaranteed relocation (if applicable) might close her.

I attached the candidate packet and the initial offer for reference.

Thanks —
Monica
Recruiting (US Hiring)
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- initial-offer-caroline.pdf (stub)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate update — Caroline Nguyen received competing offer, asks for quick decision

Thanks Monica. I want to keep Caroline in the funnel. Hiring this role is high priority for infra — we've been short on model serving bandwidth and she'll move the needle.

Approve up to +6% base (within band upper quartile) plus a one-time sign-on up to $12,000. Anything more will need Head of Eng approval (can't get that before Friday). If the candidate's counter requires more than that, escalate to me immediately and I'll pull in execs.

Please emphasize speed — give Caroline a clear window and a firm expiration. If Greystone needs a DocuSign link, we can push it today.

-Jonas
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Nguyen <caroline.nguyen@gmail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sara Lee <sara@greystonerecruit.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Offer update & limited-time sign-on — Redwood Inference

Caroline — great speaking earlier. Recruiter Monica looped me in so you're seeing a formal note. We're excited about the possibility of you joining the infra team. The hiring team confirmed we can move on the package: 

- Base: $200,000 (these are the banded numbers we discussed)
- Annual equity: 0.30% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)
- Signing bonus: $12,000 (one-time, paid first payroll) — approved as a bridge to match comp pressure
- Target start: June 7, 2027 (flexible within a two-week window)

This offer is valid through 11:59 PM PT on Friday, 2027-04-23. We realize it's a tight timeline; if you need a brief extension, tell us by EOD Thursday and we will try to accommodate.

If you accept, we'll send the DocuSign and start the onboarding checklist immediately. Attached is the approved signing letter and the role summary.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts (recruiting on behalf of hiring team)
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- approved-signing-letter.pdf (stub)
- role-summary-swe3.pdf (stub)
From: Caroline Nguyen <caroline.nguyen@gmail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lee <sara@greystonerecruit.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer update & limited-time sign-on — Redwood Inference

Hi Ben — thanks for the fast follow-up and for the signing bonus, I appreciate the team moving quickly. I have two quick questions before I sign: 
1) Is there any flexibility on base to get closer to the competing offer? They're at $216k base.
2) Would Redwood be open to a 6-month performance review with potential merit increase tied to delivery milestones?

My timeline: I can sign by EOD Friday if we keep the deadline, but I'd like clarity on the base or a defined review path to make the decision. Happy to take a short call if that's easier.

Thanks —
Caroline
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer update & limited-time sign-on — Redwood Inference

Looping back with a documented exception. We pushed the comp modeling: we can approve a one-time band exception equivalent to +5% above the posted band midpoint for this role and a $15,000 sign-on instead of $12,000 — conditional on candidate signing by 2027-04-23 11:59 PM PT. Please find the comp-notes attached (approvals from TotalComp and Finance).

Actions:
- Monica: send the revised offer (update base to $210,000, sign-on $15k) and DocuSign link.
- Ben / Jonas: confirm you are OK with the conditional timeline (no further extensions unless exec sign-off).

Marissa
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- comp-band-exception-note.txt (stub)
- finance-approval-20270422.pdf (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Nguyen <caroline.nguyen@gmail.com>

Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 23:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer update & limited-time sign-on — Redwood Inference

Caroline — quick good news: we were able to secure an exception. Revised package below (final, approved):
- Base: $210,000
- Annual equity: 0.30% (4-year vesting)
- Signing bonus: $15,000 (one-time)
- 6-month performance checkpoint with a candid conversation about merit if defined delivery milestones are hit

This revision is conditional on signature by 11:59 PM PT tonight (2027-04-23). DocuSign link sent to your inbox — Sara should have it too. If you want a 10-minute call before signing, I can make time at 7:30 AM PT tomorrow.

We'd love to have you on the team.

—Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts (on behalf of Hiring)
Redwood Inference
